title: RepoAssure M1 Open Evidence Kernel Candidate Boundary Contract Design Planning v0.1

acceptance: Begin only after the K1 maintainer decision-recording Goal is completed with the explicit approve_for_separately_gated_contract_design choice and this exact contract-design planning Goal receives separate execution authorization.
Use only the current local K1 plan, decision record, and repository-owned evidence contracts; do not perform external-standard or provider research without separate authorization.
Prepare exactly one non-authoritative design plan for K1 while keeping every original contract and original artifact byte authoritative.

Define proposed versioning and identity semantics for sourceContract, subject, producer, evidenceIndex, outcome, reviewBoundary, writeBoundary, privacyAndRedaction, and compatibility while preserving raw status and decision vocabularies.

Require unmapped, lossy, missing identity, missing hash, missing review, missing authorization, missing observation, or missing proof-method states to remain explicit unknown or fail closed rather than passing.

Keep original contracts authoritative, M1 and M2 incomplete, M3-M5 strategy-only, auth_redirect request_revision, final acceptance defer, and every representative acquisition and execution lane defer; advance no Roadmap milestone.

Do not create or promote schemas, accept or implement an authoritative contract, implement adapters or runtime behavior, change CLI/MCP entrypoints, integrate providers, modify dependencies, run detector or behavior tests, access targets, issue receipts, publish, deploy, launch, commit, push, or create a pull request.
